accuracy_notes: Photo-informed original artwork: Rhincodon typus visual study. Animated tail and fins; not a scanned specimen or taxonomic identification model. Original Rhincodon typus visual study based on the inspected Erik Schlogl photograph. The broad mouth is closed; filter-feeding mechanics, fine denticles and teeth are simplified. Gill slits use shallow original relief, and movement is artist-tuned rather than measured.
